source: Brian M. Jones Faure Berceuse op.56 no.1 piano transcription
method: New restrained three-part string doubling selected from actual sustained piano notes using non-overlapping weighted intervals per register. Only octave shifts are used, no guessed triads or added chord tones. Every complete wet/dry string release remains inside its source piano key interval. Source-note holds are capped at 2.2 original seconds; automatic transcription errors remain possible.
